保誠 Prudential 2010 電視廣告「Listen to Me」

為進一步加強「用心聆聽、更知你心」的企業理念，並承諾我們用心聆聽每位客戶的需要，英國保誠集團亞洲區總部現正推出新一輯企業廣告，是集團自1995年推廣「用心聆聽」企業理念以來，最大規模的品牌廣告宣傳活動。此企業廣告將陸續於亞洲9個市場播放，而英國保誠香港分行亦於今天起推出30秒電視廣告及多個大型戶外廣告。 電視廣告以四位不同性格及造型的人物角色，演繹並加深我們「用心聆聽」的企業理念和形象，更重點向公眾表達「專業理財策劃，由用心聆聽開始」的企業訊息。 To reinforce "Always Listening. Always Understanding" platform and emphasize our commitment in providing products and services that meet customers' needs, Prudential Corporation Asia (PCA) rolls out a new branding campaign which is the largest ever since the launch of its "Listening" credo in 1995. The campaign will be progressively launched in nine Asian markets and PACHK is launching a 30-second TV commercial and various outdoor media today. Featuring four characters with different personalities and styles, our TV commercial not only helps to enhance "Listening" corporate credo, but also conveys a message of "We believe professional financial solutions always start with listening" to the public.
Prudential Hong Kong Limited 香港保誠保險
